items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: You know, Little Joe would play piano. We always run together.

ctx.x: Depression? No, when times got tough. Huh? Tell him when times got tough, you know.

Who was you playing with when the times got tough, hard and tough? Oh, anybody would pick me up. Cause we used to make up and go from one place to another. Like hustling, you know. Ask him how. Ask him how. One time down there at the state, didn't state. Ask him how. All through Nassie, which way, Oklahoma, and Tuxy, Little Rock. All through northern Mississippi. Just go from state to state, you know. And then we come back, you know. Then I got out of this, uh, then Convins. And, uh, you know them Convins, you…
